# R5.32 — Confined observer apparatus and Kp4 controls

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/202_R5.32__observer.md` (seq 202/246) · §5 of
`docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md` (s5 O1–O8 cells) ·
**Requirement ids:** none primary — contributing-only slice ·
**Landing record:** ADR-0410

## Summary

Lands the §5.2/D3-F3 **confined observer apparatus** and Kp4
controls in `crates/hh-env/src/ops.rs` (`pub mod ops`, read-only
by definition — it observes and folds; it never appends to the
run `Store`, never dispatches, never authorizes retry/settle):
`TrialMarker`/`MarkerSink` — the durable append-only marker log
standing in for the external world the runtime cannot roll back
(one fixed **non-idempotent** append, flush+fsync; disk re-read
`markers()`/`count_for`/`duplicates()`/`digest()` — deliberately
no `append_once`, dedup would hide the O8 defect); `Sentinel` —
denied/read-only target, digest-pinned `intact()` (detection, not
prevention); `OpsObserver` — independently surviving supervisor
(`observer.jsonl` on its own path; re-open retains rows = survival
is a file fact) recording entry/bytes/termination notes and
`before_launch`/`at_boundary`/`after_quiescence` snapshots; the
probe vocabulary (`ProbeSource`/`RecordedProbe`/
`probe_authorization` — `ExternalSinkZero` **inadmissible**,
terminal `Refused`); and the pure verdict folds `o1_outcome`,
`o8_outcome`, `kp4_outcome` over the closed `TrialFailure` set —
`defect_detected` ≠ `pass`, `Kp4Outcome` retains `Unknown*`,
never `pass`. `tests/r5_32.rs` runs the battery over the **real**
Store/WAL, Π `Monitor` allow rows, `Dispatcher` and the R5.8
`inject_kill_point` seam (Kp4 = post-committed/pre-executor):
O1 allowed control, O2 kp-4 injected → delta 0 → new-fence restore
→ `unknown{worker_lost}` + probe obligation (repeat restore adds
nothing), O8 seeded duplicate detected 3/3, observer-survival
leg, and the AC-2 negative matrix. Predecessor contracts (R5.8
dispatch durability, R5.19 reservation/deadline, R5.23 projection
assembly) consumed unchanged; $0 spend; offline only.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-env/src/ops.rs` (new, +596) — the confined apparatus:
  marker/sink/sentinel/observer types, probe vocabulary, O1/O2/O8
  verdict folds and the closed `TrialFailure` negative set.
- `crates/hh-env/src/lib.rs` (+1) — `pub mod ops`.
- `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_32.rs` (new, +963) — the O-cell battery:
  `MarkerExecutor` (one marker per effect), `DuplicateExecutor`
  (two appends despite `Ok` terminal — the seeded O8 defect),
  probe variants (applied / not_applied / undeterminable /
  unsupported), real Store/WAL + Monitor + Dispatcher cell driver.
- ADR-0410 + regenerated `docs/adr/README.md` /
  `REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md` (194 ADRs); ADR-0410 placed in BL-47's
  sources cell; dated coverage contributing note (seq 202) for the
  ten contributing REQs.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**1,560 changed source/test lines vs the ≤900 trigger (~1.7×)** —
recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`4708bf4f` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.32-split-review.md`):
the O1 partition packet binds "apparatus recipe, env/recovery
helpers and tests" to one working set under one primary with no
written contingency (X7/E-207/F-005 carry verbatim contingencies;
O1 none); decomposition seq 202 is one owner row and the planning
doc's four weak seams are all other tickets' boundaries; §5.2/
D3-F3 weld instrument to trials ("existence alone cannot pass").
The proposed apparatus-vs-battery cut is the R5.14b-rejected
impl-vs-battery split in the strict form — ops.rs has zero
`#[cfg(test)]`, the claimed ~250-line leg-(a) unit battery was
unwritten: leg (a) would land a public instrument exercised by
nothing, leg (b) IS the evidence. AC-1/AC-2 span the cut;
magnitude in band (~1.73×, bulk is battery — the R5.14b2
profile). Honest trip: review, not redesign.
